note: Enntity/atlas q27/conc (with three prefix-cache fixes for long conversations and the shared-scan decode attention): q27/rc1 (q27/gdn-defer, the Qwen3.8-27B single-Spark serving work: exact MTP and DFlash2 verify, single-sequence and batched, fused GDN decode and verify with a deferred exact commit, row-invariant tensor-core skinny GEMMs; merged with q27/fp4-gdn, native NVFP4 GDN projections) with q27/dspine (the DSpine drafter and --draft-model-alt) and the concurrency series: deferred-commit-only verify pools, no MTP head under DFlash, the GDN qkv/z sources freed, the drafter's per-sequence pools in the KV budget, DFlash verify width that follows the batch (plain decode past sixteen sequences) an exact LM head for batched decode past sixteen, a wall-time decode share during long prefills (ATLAS_DECODE_TIME_SHARE), and the drafter built inside the KV budget. The pair keeps install/atlas-source.json, and a restore ladder in the SSM snapshot pool (log-spaced snapshots kept behind each conversation's newest save, so a prefix match that lands behind the tail restores nearby instead of recomputing the whole prompt); and the swap-out gate sizes its reclaim by the blocks a request will allocate, so it no longer evicts the tail of the cached prefix the request is about to reuse (past half the KV pool the match had become pool minus prompt); and an interval SSM checkpoint at every prefill chunk end that crosses the interval, so an idle server's arena-sized first chunk no longer leaves a cold prefill without one; and a BF16 paged decode attention that reads each KV head once for the rows that share its blocks and scores them on tensor cores, row-exact between serial decode and every verify width (ATLAS_ATTN_SHARED_SCAN, set by the 27B profiles); and a DFlash serve no longer fuses a prefill chunk with the decode of two or more active sequences, which left the request being prefilled with no drafter context (one token a step for its whole life, and text that could differ from serial decode).
